name: Provider
overview: Scripture reveals God as the faithful Provider who meets all our needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus, assuring believers that they will not want when the Lord is their shepherd. He is our helper who upholds our souls and guides us in truth through the Spirit. By seeking first God's kingdom and righteousness, we are promised that all necessary things will be added, grounded in the ultimate provision of His Son, given so that believers may have eternal life.
